// The inertial properties of a planar rigid body: total mass, center of mass
// in the body's local frame (meters), and the scalar moment of inertia about
// the out-of-plane axis through the center of mass.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Center_of_mass)
type MassProperties2D
    implements IValue
{
    Mass: Mass;
    CenterOfMass: Point2D;
    MomentOfInertia: MomentOfInertia;
}
